description: Source code defining the Returns model class for handling product return operations within the Opencart e-commerce platform. Contains methods for adding, retrieving, and managing return records in the database.

classes.name: Returns
classes.description: Model class for managing customer product returns. Provides methods to add new returns, retrieve specific return details, list returns, and handle return histories.

methods.name: addReturn
methods.description: Creates a new return record in the database with the provided return data, returning the ID of the new record.

methods.name: getReturn
methods.description: Fetches the detailed information for a specific return based on its return ID, including status, action, reason, comments, and dates.

methods.name: getReturns
methods.description: Retrieves a list of return records for the current customer, with optional pagination via start and limit.

methods.name: getTotalReturns
methods.description: Returns the total count of return records associated with the current customer.

methods.name: getHistories
methods.description: Gets the history entries (status changes, comments) for a specific return, with optional pagination.

methods.name: getTotalHistories
methods.description: Returns the total number of history records for a specific return.
